posts.text: Will onchain foreign exchange start on Wall Street—or on your phone? Curve Finance founder Michael Egorov argues that decentralized FX won’t wait for trillion-dollar bank liquidity. Instead, everyday cross-border payment demand and automated market makers are making smaller currency pools viable first. With cross-border stablecoin flows surging past $220B, could bottom-up adoption reshape global currency transfers? Share your take below! 👇 # OnchainFX # DeFi # Stablecoins # CrossBorderPayments # Tradepoch

posts.text: Blockchain data firm Bitquery counted 15,961 BTC at Maple Finance's disclosed Bitcoin addresses for its syrupUSDC lending pool in an 18 November snapshot, 400 BTC fewer than the 16,361 the lender reported, or 97.6%. Collateral it could trace was still worth about 152% of some 847M USD in loans. https:// cryptoslate.com/bitquery-count ed-400-fewer-btc-in-maples-disclosed-wallets-than-maple-reported/ # Web3 # Blockchain # DeFi
